fix_command:
set -e
rm -f /etc/default/grub.sf3000.bak
command -v os-prober >/dev/null || { echo "os-prober is not installed, so GRUB cannot look for Windows" >&2; exit 1; }
cp -p /etc/default/grub /etc/default/grub.sf3000.bak
if grep -qE '^[[:space:]]*#?[[:space:]]*GRUB_DISABLE_OS_PROBER=' /etc/default/grub; then
  sed -i -E 's/^[[:space:]]*#?[[:space:]]*GRUB_DISABLE_OS_PROBER=.*/GRUB_DISABLE_OS_PROBER=false/' /etc/default/grub
else
  printf '%s\n' '' '# Look for other systems, such as Windows, each time the menu is rebuilt.' 'GRUB_DISABLE_OS_PROBER=false' >> /etc/default/grub
fi
update-grub
